chunks: He replied: "I am only a messenger from your Lord to bestow upon you a good son."
ai.seo_question: What did the Angel say to Mary regarding the birth of Jesus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine command (Amr) where Gabriel, acting as the active agent of creation, announces the birth of Isa (Jesus) as a 'pure son' (Ghulaman Zakiyyan), emphasizing his sinless nature. The phrase underscores the miraculous nature of the conception without a father, serving as a sign of God's absolute power to create from nothing, a theme central to the Imams' teachings on the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophets.
